name: How much does window lock repair typically cost in the Bay Area?

mainEntity.name: How much does window lock repair typically cost in the Bay Area?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of window lock repair in the Bay Area can vary significantly depending on the type of window (e.g., single-hung, double-hung, casement), the complexity of the lock mechanism, and whether replacement parts are readily available. Minor repairs, such as adjusting a strike plate, might be less expensive than replacing an entire locking assembly. We provide transparent estimates after assessing the specific issue with your window lock.
